message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Location | Pet Policy (Amtrak) | Notes | |---------|----------|---------------------|-------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)** | 1 Seaboard Ave, Miami, FL 33132 | • Pets are allowed in the **baggage car** (not in the passenger car).
• Must be in a **carrier** that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• Must be leashed or in a carrier at all times.
• No pets in the dining car or on the platform.
• Amtrak’s “Pet Friendly” policy applies; check Amtrak’s website for the latest rules. | • The station serves Amtrak’s **Silver Service** (Miami to New York) and the **Florida East Coast Railway** (freight).
• It’s a modern, fully accessible hub with elevators, restrooms, and a waiting area.
• The station is located near the Miami International Airport and the **Miami Intermodal Center** complex, making it easy to connect to other transit options.
• Contact: 305‑555‑1234 (customer service) or visit the Amtrak website for pet‑specific questions. | ### How to Use the Station with Your Pet 1. **Check Amtrak’s Pet Policy** - Visit the Amtrak website or call their customer service to confirm the latest pet rules, especially if you’re traveling with a larger dog or multiple pets. 2. **Prepare Your Pet** - Bring a sturdy carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area. - Have a leash, water bowl, and any necessary medication ready. - Label the carrier with your contact information. 3. **Arrive Early** - Give yourself extra time to navigate the station, especially if you need to find the baggage car or a quiet spot for your pet. 4. **During the Journey** - Keep your pet in the carrier or on a leash. - Follow any station signage regarding pet areas. 5. **After Arrival** - If you’re staying in Miami, you can easily transfer to the **Miami Metromover**, **Metrobus**, or a taxi from the Intermodal Center. --- #### Quick Contact Details - **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA) – Amtrak** Phone: **305‑555‑1234** Address: 1 Seaboard Ave, Miami, FL 33132 Website: [Amtrak – Miami](https://www.amtrak.com/stations/mia) - **Amtrak Pet Policy** Website: [Amtrak – Pets](https://www.amtrak.com/pets) Feel free to let me know if you need help booking a ticket, finding nearby pet-friendly accommodations, or anything else!
